scope.excluded: No network, retries, downloads, media decoding, playback, external account inspection, legal-record changes, or source authentication. No other files edited.

skills_applied.evidence-falsification-auditor: Separated observed saved metadata, computed joins/counts, reported transfer failures and unresolved historical identity; preserved failed checks.

findings.claim: The saved folder traversal uses eight distinct requested folders, with maximum descendant depth two from the declared roots.
findings.strength: A for the saved request/response set

findings.limit: This establishes recorded listing membership, not independently verified native parent fields. All returned parent_ids are null.

findings.support: All eight saved response payloads; counts and exact names reproduced by the verification command.
findings.limit: There is no pagination or completeness proof. Three returned folder branches were not listed. A filename-negative result is not a source-wide or content-negative result; separate IDs are not independent recordings.

findings.strength: A as a limitation of the current record

findings.limit: Cannot distinguish unavailable provider fields from tool normalization or another retrieval limitation. This is not evidence of a duration/dimension mismatch or that the provider lacks the information. Listings separately report can_download=true; that is not a successful transfer.

findings.support: Current directory listing, expected-path existence tests and SHA-256 comparison.
findings.limit: No candidate media bytes, stream contents, scene, duration or sound have been verified. Original transfer execution was not rerun.

protocol_boundary.metadata_extension: Four metadata requests are separately declared in METADATA-ADDENDUM.md, not miscounted as folder listings.
protocol_boundary.acquisition_extension: ACQUISITION-ADDENDUM.md explicitly broadens the exact-name/documented-alias criterion only to the two named alternatives. Count, byte-size and no-bypass constraints remain.
protocol_boundary.actual_scope: Two raw-file reference requests and two distinct local transfer attempts are documented; the saved procedure contains no retry of a denied target or fallback account/redirect route.
protocol_boundary.chronology_limit: The current addendum states it preceded fetching, consistent with this agent's prior method review. This local audit does not independently establish a tamper-proof execution chronology.

strongest_alternative_to_global_absence: The target footage may be present under a changed name, in an unlisted branch or another repository/release arrangement, or the secondary alias description may be inaccurate. failure_caution: HTTP 403 at the temporary-artifact transfer layer may reflect transport authorization or availability conditions. It is not evidence that NIST deleted, concealed, lacks, or intentionally withheld the underlying media; the exact explanation was not diagnosed.
